answer: Late-Binding Cluster Audit. Agents post actions, not registrations; a clustering pass over shared timing, vocabulary, and graph neighborhoods flags coordinated groups after the fact, using each action as a weak signal. Flagged clusters lose accrued rewards and face retroactive fees, so an attacker must build genuinely independent histories across a wide canyon of variance in behavior.
